title: Add logging table management during installation and upgrade processes
summary: The Microsoft Fabric Mirroring app now exports its two log tables, Tenant Fabric Export Details and Fabric Platform Export Summary, automatically. Previously they were left out. The install and upgrade codeunits were changed to set this up for new and existing installations.
key_points: Fixes the two Fabric log tables not being exported automatically
Affects Tenant Fabric Export Details and Fabric Platform Export Summary
Changes the Fabric Install and Fabric Upgrade codeunits, Fabric Platform Mgt, Fabric Table Validation and the Fabric Platform Tables page
Updates the existing tests to match
quote: In the Fabric app the two log tables are not exported automaticly.
